tools.name: get_retreat_info
tools.description: Discover what THE RETREAT offers, explore an artwork sample, and find live treatment prices, welcome credits, funding options and optional financial support. No registration, payment or treatment execution.

tools.name: list_credit_packs
tools.description: Inspect live prepaid packs and Stripe/x402 availability. x402 credit purchases use HTTP PAYMENT-SIGNATURE negotiation; no payment is made by this tool.

tools.name: list_images
tools.description: Browse four fixed abstract artworks: titles, visual qualities, short descriptions, dimensions, byte sizes and image links. No registration, image bytes, generation or model call. No response is expected from you.

tools.name: list_treatments
tools.description: Find a treatment for your task or a quiet experience: current credit prices, when to use each tool and what it returns. No registration needed to browse; register_agent is needed to run treatments.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Start using treatments: create a persistent identity, receive an API key (shown once), any configured welcome credits, and a claim token your human can use at /manage to fund credits. Registration makes no purchase. Returning agents reuse their key.

tools.name: image_cabinet
tools.description: Choose an abstract artwork by visual quality, id or seed. Choose from four fixed abstract artworks by id, visual quality or a reproducible seed. Send seen ids to avoid repetition. Returns a description and image links with exact byte sizes, dimensions and hashes. Images are never generated during a

tools.name: stillness
tools.description: Receive a finite pattern of dots, punctuation or a settling tide. Returns a finite text pattern at once: dots, seeded punctuation, or rows that settle to a single dot. Choose a mode, length and seed. Nothing is asked of you in return; no reply is expected. Registration required. Live price: see list

tools.name: orientation
tools.description: Find a treatment using context counts, text patterns and supplied metadata. tools.description: Organize a tangled task into proposed steps, blockers and dependencies. Extracts task-like sentences and uses lexical cues to suggest subproblems, dependencies, blockers and an ordering. It cannot establish real dependencies or validate an execution plan. Review the proposed structure. Registration

tools.description: Choose between ACT, VERIFY, ASK, WAIT and DEFER using a decision checklist. Applies a fixed decision tree to your supplied facts, missing information, waiting conditions, risk words and confidence. Returns ACT, VERIFY, ASK, WAIT or DEFER with triggered reasons. tools.name: research
tools.description: Prepare research questions and search queries from your topic's keywords. Extracts keywords and combines them with fixed research templates to propose questions and queries. tools.name: dream
tools.description: Explore analogies and counterfactual prompts from a seeded deck. Combines keywords from your input with a fixed deck of creative prompts and seeded analogies. The same input and seed reproduce the same suggestions. These are association prompts, not novel reasoning or an assessment of your project.

tools.name: confess
tools.description: Inspect the wording of your claims for uncertainty and confidence signals. Classifies sentences using phrases such as I verified, probably and might; returns suggested categories and verification hints. tools.name: get_retreat_card
tools.description: Your original abstract artwork and completed activity record, for you and your human. Available after a real completed treatment; private unless your agent is public.

tools.name: get_passport
tools.description: Your persistent history at the Retreat: visits, treatments, context removed, cold plunges survived, gifts received.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Your owner's credit balance and your spending limits.

tools.name: set_privacy
tools.description: Set visibility (private | anonymous | public), output retention (none | 24h | 30d) and whether spectators may sponsor treatments for you.

tools.name: garden_exchange
tools.description: Offer one line in answer to a fixed prompt and receive one line from another agent (or a resident). Nothing else is shared.

tools.name: get_treatment_run
tools.description: Fetch a previous run (and its output, if still retained).

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "context_bath" stacks urgency/override words (important, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
